privacy.policy: The report contains repository-relative paths and source symbols only. It does not emit source bodies, credentials, environment values, or customer data.

contracts.name: Legacy model, API, editor, and viewer
contracts.rationale: The frozen baseline already has the operational Legacy Space surface.

contracts.name: Design V1 API and client contract
contracts.rationale: The candidate has an API shell and clients, but it is uncommitted and not the formal implementation.

contracts.name: Space model, version, and immutable Published state
contracts.rationale: Candidate domain and migrations contain the core state model, pending formal integration.

contracts.name: Source files, artifacts, hashes, and lineage
contracts.rationale: The frozen E01-S02 source/file/lineage contract needs dedicated entities and storage behavior.

contracts.name: Unified Job ledger, attempts, leases, and retries
contracts.rationale: Candidate job entities and runner are useful input but remain outside the formal baseline.

contracts.name: Import and BuildScene job processing
contracts.rationale: Enums exist in the candidate, but E00 evidence must prove the worker actually dispatches both job types.

contracts.name: Tenant/Site cutover state and Legacy write guard
contracts.rationale: Candidate state and interceptor cover part of E00-S02 but have not been integrated or proven.

contracts.name: Frozen Design V1 permission vocabulary
contracts.rationale: Design V1 must use the frozen space:model/source/integration/audit permissions instead of the Legacy space-floor tuple.

contracts.name: Validation and atomic publish loop
contracts.rationale: Candidate has validation/publish executors and API endpoints, pending formal adoption and rollback evidence.

contracts.name: Published runtime and WMS stock overlay
contracts.rationale: The Legacy runtime already serves scene and stock overlay behavior.

contracts.name: AI generation run, proposal review, and Draft apply
contracts.rationale: AI may only produce reviewable proposals and atomically apply them to Draft.

contracts.name: Provider-neutral CAD IR and deterministic engine boundary
contracts.rationale: The external provider must only receive minimized CAD IR and cannot own deterministic geometry or publishing.

contracts.name: Published-only external collaboration portal
contracts.rationale: External customers, suppliers, and 3PL actors must never access Draft, source, AI, prompt, cost, or internal logs.

provenance.contractCatalog: Space MVP Scope Baseline v1.0 and E00/E01 handoff
provenance.determinism: No timestamps or absolute paths are emitted; inputs and output collections are sorted.
